verdict.rationale: Runloop's Blueprints are documented as template images for devbox startup. They can be built from your own Dockerfile (`rli blueprint from-dockerfile`), reused across Devboxes, or chosen from public prebuilt blueprints, and snapshots add saved-state templates on top of that. missing for 10: explicit evidence of importing an existing prebuilt image from a container registry (as opposed to building from a Dockerfile), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
